description_en: Queries the current list of name servers for a domain name and determines whether the servers are managed by Alibaba Cloud DNS
description_zh: 根据传入域名获取域名当前的NS服务器列表，以及NS是否属于阿里云解析管理
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-domain-ns --lang en --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainNs

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values: zh: Chinese
en: English
Default value: **zh**
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

zh：中文       
en：英文           

默认取值为**zh**
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:

<props="intl">You can call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/latest/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains) operation to obtain this value.</props>

<props="intl">可通过调取[DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取</props>
parameters.name: domain_name
